features.title: AI-Optimized Generation
features.description: Machine learning models continuously tune panel orientation, inverter settings, and load distribution to maximize output across changing conditions.

features.title: Predictive Maintenance
features.description: Sensors and anomaly detection flag degradation and faults before they become failures — keeping uptime high and service calls low.

features.title: Real-Time Monitoring

features.title: Blockchain-Verified Green Credits
